episodes.title: What I Didn't Share on Cults to Consciousness | More Childhood Stories (LIVE)
episodes.description:
If you found me through Cults to Consciousness, welcome. ❤️ 

There's so much more to my story than we could fit into one interview.Today I'm going live to share more stories from my childhood, the things I once believed were normal, the truths I uncovered as I got older, and what it's been like to rebuild my life after everything.Some of these stories are heartbreaking, some are unbelievable, and some I can finally laugh about. All of them are part of how I got here.Whether you've followed my story for years or you're just discovering it, I'm so glad you're here. 

**I'll also be doing a separate LIVE Q&A later today or tomorrow, so leave your questions in the comments!**Subscribe so you don't miss it. ❤️ 

#CultsToConsciousness #ChildhoodTrauma #FamilySecrets #HealingJourney #CycleBreaker
